claims.statement: The system architecture consists of three primary components: the API Service, the Ingestion Pipeline, and the Evaluation Service, operating within an event-driven serverless environment.
The ingestion pipeline uses an SQS-based fan-out mechanism to scale crawling tasks, and S3-based manifest deduplication to minimize DynamoDB read costs.
Ingestion performance is optimized by decoupling heavy external dependencies, utilizing custom lightweight text splitters, and offloading sparse vector generation to the Qdrant server.
